items.exampleEn: The train station was in chaos after the trains stopped.
items.exampleZh: 火車停駛後，車站一片混亂。

items.exampleEn: The amount of homework overwhelmed the students.
items.exampleZh: 大量的作業讓學生們招架不住。

items.exampleEn: The fire had a devastating effect on the forest.
items.exampleZh: 那場火對森林造成毀滅性的影響。
items.glossZh: 毀滅性的；令人極為難過的

items.exampleEn: At New Year, many families hope for prosperity in the coming year.
items.exampleZh: 新年時，很多家庭期盼來年富足興旺。

items.exampleEn: The team made a breakthrough after testing hundreds of ideas.
items.exampleZh: 團隊測試了上百個點子之後，終於有了突破。

items.exampleEn: Strong winds can be very destructive.
items.exampleZh: 強風的破壞力可能非常大。

items.exampleEn: Please keep quiet to avoid any disturbance to other guests.
items.exampleZh: 請保持安靜，以免打擾其他房客。

items.sentenceEn: The new rules caused chaos at the airport.
items.sentenceZh: 新規定在機場造成了混亂。

items.audioEn: Sorry for the disturbance, but we need to check the lights in your room.
items.audioZh: 抱歉打擾了，我們需要檢查您房間裡的燈。
options: To check the heater in the room.

items.sentenceEn: The breakthrough came after years of hard work.
items.sentenceZh: 經過多年的努力，終於有了突破。

items.sentenceEn: Too much information can overwhelm new staff.
items.sentenceZh: 太多資訊可能會讓新員工招架不住。

items.stemEn: Some insects are ____ to farms because they eat the crops.
items.stemZh: 有些昆蟲對農場有破壞性，因為牠們會吃農作物。

items.stemEn: The invention of the phone was a major ____ in communication.
items.stemZh: 電話的發明是通訊上的一大突破。

items.passageEn: When the old factory closed, our town fell into chaos. The majority of the workers lost their jobs, and the news was devastating. Some families were overwhelmed by money problems. Then came a breakthrough: a technology company decided to build an office in the town. At first, the building work caused some disturbance, and some people said it would be destructive to the quiet town. But in the end, it brought new jobs and prosperity.
items.passageZh: 老工廠關閉時，我們小鎮陷入一片混亂。大多數工人都失業了，這個消息令人極為難過。有些家庭被錢的問題壓得喘不過氣。後來出現了突破：一家科技公司決定在鎮上設辦公室。一開始，施工帶來了一些干擾，也有人說這會破壞安靜的小鎮。但最後，它帶來了新的工作和繁榮。

questions.questionZh: 工廠關閉後，小鎮發生了什麼事？
什麼為小鎮帶來了突破？
options: 鎮上的老工廠重新開張
政府每個月發錢給居民

items.promptZh: 施工的噪音對附近居民造成干擾。
referenceEn: The noise from the building work was a disturbance to people nearby.
The building noise was a disturbance to the people who live nearby.
rubricZh: disturbance 表示「干擾、打擾」，可用 be a disturbance to… 等說法
「附近居民」可寫 people nearby、people who live nearby 等

items.instructionZh: 用 prosperity 造一個句子，說說你對自己的城市或家鄉未來的希望。
referenceEn: I hope my hometown will enjoy more prosperity in the future.
I wish my city peace and prosperity.
rubricZh: prosperity 表示「繁榮」，是不可數名詞
可用 hope、wish 表達希望（例如 I hope…、I wish my city prosperity）
說的是自己對家鄉、城市等的希望（例如 I hope…）
